title: 323 Area Code: Location, Cities Served & Lookup Info
meta_description: Looking up a 323 phone number? See California cities covered across central Los Angeles, time zone information, and local dialing rules.

faqs.question: What city is the 323 area code located in?
faqs.answer: The 323 area code is located in Los Angeles, California. It covers neighborhoods surrounding the downtown core, including Hollywood, East Los Angeles, and Huntington Park.

faqs.question: What time zone does the 323 area code observe?
faqs.answer: The 323 area code operates in the Pacific Time Zone. It observes Pacific Standard Time in the winter and Pacific Daylight Time during summer months.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 213 and 323 area codes?
faqs.answer: The 213 code originally covered all of Los Angeles, while 323 was created in 1998 for the surrounding ring. Both codes now overlap and serve the same geographic footprint.

faqs.question: How do I perform a 323 phone number lookup?
faqs.answer: You can perform a reverse phone lookup using online directories, search engines, or mobile carrier apps. These tools help identify the registered owner of a specific number.

faqs.question: Is 323 a toll-free area code?
faqs.answer: No, 323 is a standard geographic area code for Los Angeles. Calls to this prefix are billed according to your standard mobile or landline calling plan.

faqs.question: When was the 323 area code established?
faqs.answer: The California Public Utilities Commission established the 323 area code in June 1998. It was introduced to relieve number exhaustion in the original 213 zone.

content_html:
Understanding the 323 Area Code

The 323 area code serves the urban core and surrounding neighborhoods of Los Angeles, California. Created in 1998 as an overlay and split from the original 213 area code, it covers regions including Hollywood, Silver Lake, and downtown adjacent communities within the Pacific Time Zone.

Telecommunication numbering plans can confuse residents and business owners alike. This reference overview breaks down everything you need to know about this specific dialing prefix.

323 Area Code Location and Geographic Boundaries

The 323 area code location completely surrounds downtown Los Angeles in a donut shape. It encompasses iconic neighborhoods like Hollywood, East Los Angeles, Huntington Park, and Inglewood.

If you want to know what city is area code 323, the answer is primarily Los Angeles and several adjacent municipalities. These communities rely on this code for landlines, mobile phones, and business communications.

The 323 Area Code Map California

Examining a 323 area code map California reveals an entirely urban footprint. It does not stretch into rural regions or northern parts of the state.

Instead, it shares borders with other Southern California prefixes. Understanding these boundaries helps prevent misdialing and clarifies regional calling habits.

Is 323 Area Code Los Angeles?

Yes, is 323 area code Los Angeles is a frequent question answered by its strict inclusion inside Los Angeles County. It exclusively serves communities inside the LA metropolitan orbit.

Residents in neighborhoods such as Boyle Heights, Glassell Park, and View Park all utilize this numbering plan. It remains a core identifier for local identity.

Difference Between 323 and 213 Area Code

The difference between 323 and 213 area code comes down to geography and history. Code 213 originally covered the entire city before running out of numbers in 1998.

Regulators introduced 323 to handle the overflow in the surrounding ring. In 2017, the California Public Utilities Commission overlaid 213 back onto the 323 zone, merging their boundaries.

323 Area Code Time Zone

The 323 area code time zone is Pacific Standard Time during winter and Pacific Daylight Time in summer. Local clocks observe daylight saving changes in coordination with the rest of the Pacific region.

Callers connecting from outside California must adjust their schedules accordingly. Business hours generally run from 9 AM to 5 PM Pacific Time.

Similarly, the 443 area code operates across Maryland. Knowing these distinctions prevents confusion when receiving long distance calls from different states.
